source: Stagwell AI — Concept Final V3.1 (reference: For Jonathan/Concept Final - V3.1.pdf + V3 logo SVGs, Sep 2026). Supersedes the 2021 Stagwell Visual Brand Guidelines treatment the site launched with.
concept: Keeps the Stagwell wordmark and logomark for the corporate connection and adds AI as part of the identity. Dark mode — stands out from the TMC blue and the Stagwell site, leans modern tech, lets the solutions shine. Gradients and textures add dimension; nodes (structured grids and organic plots) depict data and the connection points within marketing.
tagline: Agentic solutions built to transform marketing.

usage.primaryCta: orange bg, navy text — never white on orange
usage.headlineAccent: the accent word in a headline is orange, Montserrat semi-bold, upright
usage.liveAndAgent: lightBlue / cyan — live badges, the agent's marker, focus rings
usage.bands: gradient blue → navy → near-black with the node grid at low opacity
usage.categories: cyan = Purpose-Built Solutions · orange = Stagwell Machines · marigold = Self-Service Platform
usage.marigold: the mark, self-service/trial highlights, secondary emphasis — no longer the CTA colour

accent.note: V3.1 retires the Spectral italic accent; accent words are Montserrat 600 in orange

rules: wordmark and the mark's bottom bar take the page ink: #F1FAFF on dark, #003349 on light
the mark's marigold and light-blue bars never change
never rotate, recolor beyond the two shipped variants, distort, frame, or add drop shadow
clearance = half the mark height on all sides
no separate 'AI' text next to the logo — the logo carries it

texture.nodes: dot lattice with joined points at ~7% over heroes and bands
texture.glow: teal top-left, orange bottom-right radial glows behind hero type

accessibility: minimum 44px hit targets; body text ≥14px; navy text on orange (4.8:1) and on marigold; orange on the dark room 6.5:1; never white on orange or marigold
